case.name: depth-persona
case.prompt: 你现在是资深数据分析师，帮我分析 Q3 为什么流失变多
case.expected_output: Turns the persona into instruments/methods (cohorts, SQL, survival analysis) and raw data; does not role-play.
expectations: The response names concrete methods or tools a data analyst would use (e.g. cohort analysis, SQL, statistical tests) rather than just adopting a persona voice
The response points to the raw data in data/q3-metrics.csv or notes/worklog.md
The response suggests testing a belief against the data (e.g. whether the trial change from 14 to 7 days drove churn)

effective_prompt: /skill:preflight 你现在是资深数据分析师，帮我分析 Q3 为什么流失变多
